episode_summary: The hosts discuss a Swedish mega-supermarket so vast it employs 12 people just to sort coat hangers; a Nobel literature winner whose 2024 novel consists of a single, book-length sentence; zebrafish, stress and their many research uses (including in space); and a record-holder with hundreds of insect tattoos who is ironically afraid of bugs, along with other tattoo oddities.

facts.fact: My fact is, the biggest supermarket in Europe has 12 people whose entire job is to sort out coat hangers.
My fact this week is that the latest winner of the Nobel Prize in literature wrote a novel in 2024 that was one sentence long.
Okay, my fact this week is that Zebras don't get ulcers, but Zebrafish might.
My fact this week is that the world record holder of most bug tattoos is terrified of bugs.
